name: bilateral-escrow
description: Bilateral escrow on Starknet - Cairo contract with TypeScript tests, all via Docker

scripts.build: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm cairo scarb build
scripts.fmt: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm cairo scarb fmt
scripts.clean: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm cairo scarb clean
scripts.snforge: node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm cairo snforge test
scripts.accounts: npm run up && node scripts/devnet.mjs accounts
scripts.test: npm run up && node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm tests npx vitest run
scripts.test:watch: npm run up && node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm tests npx vitest
scripts.test:local: npm run up && npm --prefix tests run test --
scripts.deploy: npm run up && node scripts/compose.mjs run --rm tests npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:local: npm run up && npm --prefix tests run deploy --
scripts.setup: npm run build && npm run test
